section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the post-test and trait measures used in an experimental study examining the effects of guilt and appearance/health-focused article exposure on body anxiety and exercise motivation. Post-test measures included questions about the article, guilt and negative emotion (I-PANAS-SF), body anxiety (PASTAS), and exercise regulation (BREQ-2), with demographic information and self-reported height/weight collected for BMI calculation. Two weeks later, participants completed trait measures of body anxiety, exercise goals (GCEQ), and introjected regulation via an online survey (n = 130).
